notes.title: Deer Crusade Ultimate Demo Version!
notes.notes:
Explore the world, find the gems, defeat the enemies and solve the puzzle!


 New graphics.
 New title screen.
 New music tracks.
 New sounds.
 New special areas.
 New boss enemy.

notes.title: D3D12 Version
notes.notes: New D3D12 renderer with improved lighting, MSAA on sprites, improved font rendering and the HUD can now have the bloom effect.
